data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for generating sign-in buttons for different social media accounts.
data.what_it_does: Provides pre-styled social sign-in buttons for various platforms like Google, Facebook, Apple, and GitHub. Allows customization of button size, image position, text, color, and shape.
use_when: You need pre-styled social sign-in buttons conforming to platform guidelines
You want to quickly customize sign-in button text, colors, and layout
avoid_when: You need the actual authentication logic, as this package only provides the UI buttons
strengths: Supports many popular social media sign-in buttons out of the box
Easy to customize with properties like buttonSize, imagePosition, and custom colors
Includes mini button variants and disabled states
weaknesses: Only provides UI components, requiring separate backend or auth packages for actual authentication flow
